theory.example: At the end of a group activity, the teacher says, “Let's stop now and check our answers.”
Noticing that only a minute remains, the teacher says, “It's time to finish now. Put your pens down.”
The teacher looks at the clock and says, “It's almost time to stop, so write your final sentence.”
The class is still discussing the text when the teacher says, “We've run out of time. We'll continue tomorrow.”
Hearing the sound from the corridor, the teacher says, “There's the bell. Please put your things away.”
Before collecting the worksheets, the teacher asks, “Have you finished?”
When the timer rings, the teacher says, “Stop now and listen to the answers.”
As the lesson ends, the teacher says, “Pack up your books and get ready to leave.”
After a short written test, the teacher says, “Collect your work, please. I'll take the papers now.”
The discussion takes longer than expected, so the teacher says, “We'll have to stop here.”

theory.en: One minute to finish that activity.
theory.ru: У вас осталась одна минута, чтобы завершить это задание.
theory.example: Looking at the clock, the teacher announces, “One minute to finish that activity.”
Before dismissing the class, the teacher asks, “Are your desks tidy?”
When a pupil starts packing early, the teacher reminds them, “The bell hasn't gone yet.”

theory.en: The lesson doesn't finish till ten past.
theory.ru: Урок заканчивается только в десять минут следующего часа.
theory.example: A pupil asks whether they can leave, and the teacher replies, “The lesson doesn't finish till ten past.”

theory.en: We seem to have finished early.
theory.example: After completing the planned exercises, the teacher says, “We seem to have finished early. Let's revise the vocabulary.”
Before the pupils leave, the teacher says, “Just a moment, please. I need to explain your homework.”
As the pupils begin to stand up, the teacher says, “Just hold on a moment. I have an announcement.”
When a pupil asks a question while the teacher is writing, the teacher says, “Just a sec. I'll be right with you.”
The teacher looks for the next worksheet and says, “Just a second. I have it here.”

theory.ru: Подождите, пока не наступит нужный момент!
theory.example: During a listening exercise, the pupils reach for their pencils too early; the teacher says, “Wait for it! Start when you hear the signal.”

theory.en: There are still three minutes to go.
theory.ru: До конца урока ещё три минуты.
theory.example: As some pupils begin packing, the teacher says, “There are still three minutes to go. Let's check question five.”

theory.en: One more thing before you go.
theory.ru: И ещё кое-что, прежде чем вы уйдёте.
theory.example: Before dismissing the class, the teacher says, “One more thing before you go. Bring your reading books tomorrow.”

theory.en: We still have a couple of minutes left.
theory.ru: У нас ещё осталось пару минут.
theory.example: Looking at the clock, the teacher says, “We still have a couple of minutes left. Any questions?”
When the class moves towards the door, the teacher says, “Hang on a moment. Please leave your worksheets on the desk.”
At the end of the lesson, the teacher reminds the class, “Remember your homework. Exercise four is due tomorrow.”

theory.en: Take a worksheet as you leave.
theory.ru: Возьмите лист с заданиями, когда будете выходить.
theory.example: Before the pupils leave, the teacher says, “Take a worksheet as you leave. You'll need it for homework.”

theory.en: What do you have to do before the next lesson?
theory.ru: Что вам нужно сделать к следующему уроку?
theory.example: To check that the class understands the assignment, the teacher asks, “What do you have to do before the next lesson?”

theory.en: Prepare the next chapter for Tuesday.
theory.example: At the end of Monday's lesson, the teacher says, “Prepare the next chapter for Tuesday.”

theory.en: This is your homework for tonight.
theory.ru: Это ваше домашнее задание на сегодня.
theory.example: Pointing to an exercise on the board, the teacher says, “This is your homework for tonight.”
When the bell rings before the class completes a task, the teacher says, “Finish this exercise at home.”
After a busy week, the teacher tells the class, “There is no homework tonight. Enjoy your evening!”

theory.en: We'll do the rest of this chapter next time.
theory.ru: Оставшуюся часть этой главы мы разберём на следующем уроке.
theory.example: After introducing a new topic, the teacher says, “We'll do the rest of this chapter next time.”

theory.en: We've run out of time, so we'll continue next lesson.
theory.ru: У нас закончилось время, поэтому продолжим на следующем уроке.
theory.example: As the bell rings during a discussion, the teacher says, “We've run out of time, so we'll continue next lesson.”

theory.en: We'll continue this chapter next Monday.
theory.ru: Мы продолжим изучать эту главу в следующий понедельник.
theory.example: At the end of the Friday lesson, the teacher says, “We'll continue this chapter next Monday.”

theory.en: We'll finish this exercise next lesson.
theory.ru: Мы закончим это упражнение на следующем уроке.
theory.example: After checking the first few answers, the teacher says, “We'll finish this exercise next lesson.”

theory.en: The next class starts at 7 o'clock.
theory.ru: Следующее занятие начинается в семь часов.
theory.example: Before the pupils leave, the teacher reminds them, “The next class starts at 7 o'clock.”

theory.en: We'll do some more practice of this in the next class.
theory.ru: На следующем занятии мы ещё потренируемся выполнять такие задания.
theory.example: After the first pronunciation exercise, the teacher says, “We'll do some more practice of this in the next class.”
As the class leaves, the teacher smiles and says, “Goodbye, everyone. See you tomorrow!”
At the end of Thursday's class, the teacher says, “See you again next Thursday.”
Before the school break, the teacher says, “Have a good holiday. See you next term!”
Before the vacation begins, the teacher tells the pupils, “Enjoy your vacation. You've worked hard.”
At the end of the morning lesson, the teacher says, “See you tomorrow afternoon.”

theory.en: Form a queue and wait for the bell.
theory.ru: Встаньте в очередь и дождитесь звонка.
theory.example: Before taking the class into the corridor, the teacher instructs, “Form a queue and wait for the bell.”
As the pupils prepare to leave for lunch, the teacher says, “Get into a queue, please.”
Before the bell, the teacher reminds the pupils, “It's tidy up time. Put the materials back on the shelves.”

theory.en: Try not to make any noise as you leave.
theory.ru: Постарайтесь не шуметь, когда будете выходить.
theory.example: As the pupils approach the door, the teacher says, “Try not to make any noise as you leave.”

theory.en: Be quiet as you leave. Other classes are still working.
theory.ru: Выходите тихо. В других классах ещё идут занятия.
theory.example: The teacher reminds the pupils, “Be quiet as you leave. Other classes are still working.”
